jobs.title: VP of Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
About MoveSmart Rentals

MoveSmart Rentals is a Canadian leasing-services company helping property owners market rental properties, attract qualified tenants, and navigate the leasing process with greater speed, visibility, and support.

The business brings together property marketing, listing coordination, lead generation, digital tools, customer communication, and leasing support within one service model.

As MoveSmart Rentals expands into additional markets, we are investing in a more advanced marketing function capable of driving property-owner acquisition, strengthening the brand, improving local visibility, and supporting long-term growth across Canada.

The Position

MoveSmart Rentals is looking for a Vice President of Marketing to take ownership of the company’s marketing strategy, customer-acquisition engine, brand growth, and marketing infrastructure.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who has built and managed complex marketing functions across several markets, customer groups, campaigns, or business lines.

The person hired will be responsible for creating a more structured and measurable marketing organization. This includes deciding how work is prioritized, how campaigns are developed, how budgets are allocated, how leads are tracked, how teams are organized, and how performance is connected to customers and revenue.

The role will oversee property-owner acquisition, paid advertising, local-market growth, content, social media, SEO, reputation, public relations, partnerships, creative production, reporting, AI, automation, and marketing technology.

We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to campaign management or one marketing channel. We need an executive who can build the full marketing function and hold it accountable for business results.

Areas of Leadership

The Vice President Of Marketing Will Be Responsible For

Property-owner acquisition across multiple Canadian markets
Paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other relevant platforms
Lead-generation funnels, landing pages, remarketing, and conversion improvement
Social media, content planning, publishing, and community engagement
Video, photography, design, copywriting, testimonials, and other creative production
SEO, local search, location pages, citations, backlinks, reviews, and Google Business Profiles
Brand reputation, review growth, public complaints, and negative-review response
Public relations, partnerships, awards, media, events, podcasts, and thought leadership
Marketing dashboards, lead reporting, attribution, budget management, and customer-acquisition performance
Internal, offshore, freelance, agency, and project-based marketing resources
CRM workflows, automation, AI tools, analytics, websites, and marketing software
Brand consistency, public messaging, customer trust, and quality assurance

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Responsibilities

Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy for customer acquisition, market growth, brand visibility, and reputation
Build a clear operating structure for campaign requests, planning, production, approvals, launches, reporting, and performance review
Create consistent standards for brand messaging, creative quality, public communication, and customer-facing materials
Lead paid-media strategy and determine how advertising budgets are allocated across platforms, audiences, markets, and campaigns
Improve the quality of property-owner leads, booked consultations, conversion rates, and customer-acquisition costs
Establish clear reporting from initial inquiry through qualified lead, booked appointment, signed customer, active listing, and revenue
Create strong working relationships between marketing, sales, leasing operations, customer service, finance, and technology
Lead content, social media, video, creative, SEO, local search, PR, reputation, and partnership initiatives
Develop repeatable marketing plans for launching and growing new cities and service areas
Improve search visibility, Google rankings, reviews, brand awareness, and public trust in target markets
Partner with technology and CRM teams to improve forms, tracking, lead routing, call tracking, landing pages, follow-up automation, and attribution
Use AI, automation, and marketing software to improve speed, output, accuracy, reporting, and cost efficiency
Manage and evaluate media buyers, designers, writers, editors, SEO specialists, social media resources, analysts, PR support, and marketing coordinators
Oversee external creators and partners, including videographers, photographers, influencers, event teams, podcast teams, and agencies
Build executive reporting that clearly shows advertising spend, qualified leads, appointments, conversions, acquisition costs, SEO growth, reviews, and revenue impact
Balance priorities across markets, departments, leadership requests, campaigns, launches, and growth initiatives
Recruit, train, coach, and evaluate members of the marketing team
Address weak performance, missed deadlines, inefficient spending, tracking problems, inconsistent messaging, and quality concerns
Present leadership with clear findings, risks, recommendations, resource requirements, and growth opportunities

Experience And Qualifications

Minimum 10 years of progressive marketing experience
At least 5 of those years must have been in a senior marketing leadership role
Relevant senior roles may include Vice President of Marketing, Chief Marketing Officer, Head of Marketing, Marketing Director, Head of Growth, or a comparable position
Senior experience must include direct ownership of strategy, budgets, team performance, execution, and measurable business outcomes
Experience managing marketing across several markets, brands, business units, customer segments, or client accounts
Strong experience in performance marketing, lead generation, service-based marketing, agency operations, or multi-location growth
Experience managing remote, offshore, freelance, agency, and project-based resources
Strong paid-advertising experience across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, retargeting, landing pages, funnels, and conversion tracking
Strong understanding of lead quality, customer acquisition, attribution, sales conversion, budget optimization, and revenue reporting
Experience connecting marketing activity to CRM data, booked appointments, signed customers, active listings, or revenue
Strong SEO and local-search experience, including Google Business Profiles, location pages, citations, backlinks, reviews, content, and ranking improvement
Experience managing reputation, public complaints, negative reviews, review-generation programs, PR, media, awards, events, and brand credibility
Strong understanding of brand positioning, public messaging, creative direction, customer trust, and customer perception
Experience working with developers, CRM teams, website teams, automation specialists, analysts, and technology vendors
Strong practical experience using AI, automation, and software to improve marketing productivity and decision-making
Experience managing marketing budgets, team output, campaign performance, acquisition costs, and business results
Experience building marketing processes, reporting systems, approval structures, playbooks, and quality controls
Strong leadership, communication, organization, decision-making, and accountability skills
Ability to work successfully in a fast-moving, founder-led environment
Ontario or GTA-based candidates are preferred
Ability to attend meetings, shoots, events, planning sessions, and launches in Vaughan when required

Experience That Would Be Especially Relevant

Real estate, rentals, leasing, property management, brokerage, or home services
Lead generation for property owners, investors, or high-consideration service customers
Multi-city or multi-location growth
Building local-market launch strategies
Improving lead quality and sales conversion
Managing marketing for service businesses with strong reputation requirements
Agency leadership or responsibility for managing outside agencies
Building distributed or offshore marketing teams
CRM implementation and end-to-end marketing attribution
Referral, partnership, community, and event marketing
National or regional brand expansion
Reputation recovery or review-growth programs

Who We Are Looking For

You are a senior marketing leader who knows how to turn strategy into a reliable operating function.

You understand that success is not measured by activity alone. More posts, more clicks, and more inquiries only matter when they produce qualified property owners, booked appointments, signed customers, listings, and revenue.

You know how to build teams, assign ownership, create reporting, control budgets, and establish standards without becoming involved in every individual task.

You are comfortable managing internal staff, offshore resources, freelancers, agencies, creators, technology, AI, and automation within one coordinated structure.

You can identify weak performance quickly, challenge poor decisions, improve accountability, and keep marketing focused on business priorities.

You also understand the importance of trust in a property-services business. Brand reputation, reviews, public communication, local visibility, and customer experience are treated as core growth drivers.

How Performance Will Be Measured

Success In This Role Will Include

A consistent and predictable flow of qualified property-owner leads
Better visibility into how marketing activity converts into customers, listings, and revenue
Improved lead quality and appointment conversion
Controlled customer-acquisition costs
Stronger paid-media performance across target markets
Successful launches and growth in new cities and service areas
Improved Google rankings, local visibility, reviews, and reputation
Clear and consistent brand messaging
Higher-quality creative and content output
Reliable campaign planning, deadlines, approvals, and reporting
Clear responsibilities and accountability across the marketing team
Effective use of internal, offshore, freelance, agency, and project-based resources
Practical use of AI and automation to increase efficiency
Better alignment between marketing, sales, operations, technology, and leadership
Clear executive recommendations supported by useful data

Earnings and Incentive Plan

This role offers an annual base salary of up to C$160,000, depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, leadership background, and the scale of the marketing teams and budgets they have previously managed.
The successful candidate will also be eligible to earn up to C$60,000 annually through a performance-based leadership incentive.
The incentive is intended to reward measurable commercial impact, including improvements in customer acquisition, conversion performance, marketing efficiency, brand visibility, market expansion, team productivity, and the development of scalable marketing systems.
At full achievement, total annual compensation may reach C$220,000.
The final compensation package will reflect the candidate’s senior marketing leadership experience, history of managing complex teams and budgets, multi-market or multi-brand background, and demonstrated ability to build marketing operations that produce reliable business results.

Work Arrangement

This is a hybrid position.

The Vice President of Marketing will be expected to attend the Vaughan office when needed for leadership planning, strategy meetings, campaign launches, shoots, partnerships, events, and other important business initiatives.

Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls

A Note on Location

Primarily remote, but you must live within driving distance of our Toronto office. You’ll join us in person for every quarterly and occasionally for team get-togethers (typically 1–3 visits per quarter).

About The Team

The ideal leader combines deep systems expertise with strong product instincts and a genuine commitment to user experience. They will champion the end user, challenge assumptions, and help identify new product possibilities that may not yet be obvious.

You will work closely with product, engineering, and research to define product direction, build reliable and scalable systems, and ensure our teams have the tools and infrastructure they need to ship confidently and frequently. Identifying focus areas to improve architecture, infrastructure, system performance, and cross team technical alignment

Enabling High Quality Delivery

Going deep into architecture and designs to guide teams through ambiguity and complexity
Helping engineers make architectural tradeoffs that balance speed with long term maintainability
Ensuring projects stay on track and are communicated clearly to stakeholders
Supporting teams in shipping frequently, safely, and with high confidence, consistent with Blue J’s engineering culture

Strengthening the Engineering Organization

Coaching and developing engineers into strong system thinkers and leaders
Improving engineering practices that support quality, lean iteration, strong testing, and healthy system design
Hiring high performing engineers and engineering managers who raise the bar
Creating clarity around ownership, mandates, interfaces, and platform boundaries across pods

10+ years of hands-on experience designing and building heavily used customer facing SaaS products.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including responsibility for multiple teams or engineering managers.
Evidence that you have helped shape innovative products and technical direction in partnership with Product and Design, bringing an entrepreneurial and creative mindset rather than simply delivering against an established roadmap.
Strong architectural foundation with experience owning complex systems end-to-end - including roadmap creation, system design, implementation, and long-term evolution.

Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior level IC when needed, especially during early context-building.
Track record of identifying critical issues, setting clear goals, and shaping the technical strategy for engineering organizations.
Experience aligning engineering, product, design, and legal research around shared outcomes and coordinated execution.
Clear communication skills with the ability to explain complex system designs to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience guiding teams through architectural decisions, refactors, and long-term platform modernization.

Experience with product-led growth, customer activation, experimentation, conversion, engagement, or retention.
Experience building enterprise authentication, authorization, permissions, account structures, collaboration, billing, or purchasing systems.
Experience using product analytics and experimentation to guide technical and product decisions.

These may evolve as our platform grows. Technologies currently in use include:

Node.js, React, TypeScript, Python
AWS, Cloudflare, Terraform
Kubernetes with ArgoCD, Docker
GitHub
PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Pinecone, DynamoDB, S3
Kafka, NATS

What We Offer You

A meaningful leadership role shaping the platform foundation of a fast growing company.
A mission-driven culture where your work directly advances clarity, efficiency, and accessibility in tax research.
Competitive base salary, stock options, and benefits designed to support you and your family.
Flexibility in how you work: primarily remote, with occasional travel to our Toronto office
A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive team that values innovation, respect, and fun.
The excitement of a fast-growing, well-funded company with clear momentum, and the resources to back bold initiatives.

The Core Values that Define Our Culture

We are customer-focused
We put team over self
We are pleasant and playful
We are open to better ideas
We move fast and fix things

What To Expect In The Interview Process

We anticipate a high volume of applicants for this role and are excited to grow our team. A human will review each application and get back to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with you!

Meet our VP of Engineering, Mario

Blue J is the leading generative AI solution for tax professionals and one of Canada's fastest-growing AI companies. Headquartered in Toronto, we're a high-growth B2B SaaS company building industry-leading tax research software that helps accountants find accurate answers to complex tax questions with greater speed and confidence, supporting workflows across compliance, advisory, training, tax writing, and more.

Backed by a $176M USD Series E funding round, we're scaling rapidly across North America and the UK while continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. By combining advanced technology with deep tax expertise, we empower tax professionals to work more efficiently, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to their clients.

A Note on Location

Primarily remote, but you must live within driving distance of our Toronto office. You’ll join us in person for every quarterly and occasionally for team get-togethers (typically 1–3 visits per quarter).

To help you get off to a great start, we bring all new team members together for their first three days of onboarding. If you’re based outside of our local commuting area, Blue J will arrange and cover your travel and accommodation.

About The Team

Blue J’s technology creates value when tax professionals can easily discover, trust, and incorporate it into their work. The Tax Pro Engagement pillar owns that experience, including onboarding, search, collaboration, account management, purchasing, integrations, and core customer workflows.

As Director of Engineering, you will set the pillar’s technical and organizational direction, lead multiple product-engineering teams, and partner with Engineering and Product leadership to shape priorities and measure customer value.

You will initially immerse yourself in our product, architecture, customers, and codebase while contributing to technical design and complex problem-solving. Over time, your focus will shift toward scaling the teams, leaders, systems, and practices supporting the pillar.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering that will guide the evolution of Blue J’s platform architecture and help our engineering teams deliver high quality products at speed. This role is ideal for someone who is a strong system designer, deeply experienced with building SaaS platforms, and energized by helping teams navigate technical complexity.

The ideal leader combines deep systems expertise with strong product instincts and a genuine commitment to user experience. They will champion the end user, challenge assumptions, and help identify new product possibilities that may not yet be obvious.

You will work closely with product, engineering, and research to define product direction, build reliable and scalable systems, and ensure our teams have the tools and infrastructure they need to ship confidently and frequently. This leader will coach senior engineers, help untangle difficult architectural challenges, jump into code and designs when needed, and grow a team made up of strong software engineers.

This role is designed for a technical leader who enjoys building, mentoring, and shaping the foundational platform that enables world class product development.

What You’ll Be Doing

Setting Direction

Using customer insight, product metrics, and experimentation to guide priorities, evaluate product decisions, and continuously improve the user experience
Collaborating with product and engineering leaders to define goals and priorities
Tying engineering work to measurable outcomes such as activation, adoption, engagement, conversion, retention, workflow completion, performance, and customer trust
Owning the long term vision for platform capabilities that support reliability, scalability, developer experience, and speed of delivery
Identifying focus areas to improve architecture, infrastructure, system performance, and cross team technical alignment

Enabling High Quality Delivery

Leading platform engineers to design and build foundational systems and internal tools
Going deep into architecture and designs to guide teams through ambiguity and complexity
Helping engineers make architectural tradeoffs that balance speed with long term maintainability
Ensuring projects stay on track and are communicated clearly to stakeholders
Supporting teams in shipping frequently, safely, and with high confidence, consistent with Blue J’s engineering culture

Strengthening the Engineering Organization

Coaching and developing engineers into strong system thinkers and leaders
Improving engineering practices that support quality, lean iteration, strong testing, and healthy system design
Hiring high performing engineers and engineering managers who raise the bar
Creating clarity around ownership, mandates, interfaces, and platform boundaries across pods

What You Offer Blue J

10+ years of hands-on experience designing and building heavily used customer facing SaaS products.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including responsibility for multiple teams or engineering managers.
Evidence that you have helped shape innovative products and technical direction in partnership with Product and Design, bringing an entrepreneurial and creative mindset rather than simply delivering against an established roadmap.
Strong architectural foundation with experience owning complex systems end-to-end - including roadmap creation, system design, implementation, and long-term evolution.
Ability to design and reason about scalable distributed systems, including performance, reliability, consistency, and cost tradeoffs.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior level IC when needed, especially during early context-building.
Track record of identifying critical issues, setting clear goals, and shaping the technical strategy for engineering organizations.
Experience aligning engineering, product, design, and legal research around shared outcomes and coordinated execution.
Clear communication skills with the ability to explain complex system designs to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience guiding teams through architectural decisions, refactors, and long-term platform modernization.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

Experience with product-led growth, customer activation, experimentation, conversion, engagement, or retention.
Experience building enterprise authentication, authorization, permissions, account structures, collaboration, billing, or purchasing systems.
Experience using product analytics and experimentation to guide technical and product decisions.

Technologies You Can Expect To Work With

These may evolve as our platform grows. Technologies currently in use include:

Node.js, React, TypeScript, Python
AWS, Cloudflare, Terraform
Kubernetes with ArgoCD, Docker
GitHub
PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Pinecone, DynamoDB, S3
Kafka, NATS

What We Offer You

A meaningful leadership role shaping the platform foundation of a fast growing company.
A mission-driven culture where your work directly advances clarity, efficiency, and accessibility in tax research.
Competitive base salary, stock options, and benefits designed to support you and your family.
Flexibility in how you work: primarily remote, with occasional travel to our Toronto office
A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive team that values innovation, respect, and fun.
The excitement of a fast-growing, well-funded company with clear momentum, and the resources to back bold initiatives.

The Core Values that Define Our Culture

We are customer-focused
We put team over self
We are pleasant and playful
We are open to better ideas
We move fast and fix things

What To Expect In The Interview Process

We anticipate a high volume of applicants for this role and are excited to grow our team. A human will review each application and get back to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with you!

Interview Process

Chat with Elli, our Talent Acquisition Manager
Meet our VP of Engineering, Mario
Technical Deep Dive with an Engineering Team Member
System Design Exercise
Leadership interview with our VP of Engineering, Mario
Meet our CTO, Brett
Meet our CEO, Ben

We believe our strength is built on diversity of thought, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. We value inclusiveness and are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We strive to create an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know in your application. Our team is dedicated to providing the necessary support and making reasonable adjustments to ensure a smooth process for everyone.

How We Use AI In Our Hiring Process

To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Blue J uses AI-enabled tools within our applicant tracking system to help organize applications and highlight profiles that match the key requirements for each role.

AI does not make hiring decisions.

Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans.

We use these tools to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment and we’re committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.
